contract: One Run's serialized leased resource: one active use and bounded FIFO, immutable intent dispatch through EffectIntent, neutral PatternStep inputs, lost-on-recovery cleanup without reopen, pause/deadline policy and one total-lifetime Budget settlement; host-authorized evidence and physical fencing required.
limits: No real provider, ownership transfer, Run engine, authentication or authorization engine; the trusted host supplies exact-action approval, typed name grants and binding/owner correspondence.
A resource lease is revision fencing, not authentication or physical-send fencing; the host reconciles and physically fences delayed old work before confirming resource closure.
Memory recovery, test-provider fencing and host consumption are finite scenarios, not production storage durability, exactly-once execution or cross-node clock guarantees.
Retained state/receipts/history grow until existing Store capacity fails closed; no pruning, checkpoint, ack, pagination, subscription or total mailbox bound.

Host retains pure Budget state/generation and durably consumes resource entries with destination updates/cursor or destination deduplication before advancing cursor; it does not reset spend through Budget.Owner restart.

Provider data is portable JSON-domain data; canonical intent arguments are at most 65,536 bytes, identity fields follow EffectIntent bounds, and caller timeouts or unknown dispatches are not cancellation or resend authority.

grounding.claim: Seven named acceptance groups: serial_use_and_bounded_wait; same_run_typed_name_grant; open_unknown_never_reopens; run_end_close_and_late_event; orphan_cleanup_requires_host_grant; pause_stay_close_and_deadline; paused_usage_survives_empty_budget. Controlled Binding/Adapter provider, Memory Store/Lease recovery, host activation and replay consumption, checked example, timeout, obsolete dispatch, late reconciliation and total-rounding boundary scenarios; finite tests, not a universal proof or production durability claim.
Relies on GenServer serialization and call exit/timeout semantics; Process.send_after delivers renewal/deadline messages without a delivery-latency guarantee.
OTP 29.1.2 process mailbox and timer semantics; no physical cancellation or cross-node clock guarantee inferred.
Version-1 retained resource records use JSON objects, arrays, string tags and explicit base64 bytes through the existing JSON implementation.

Host supplies authenticated context/outer grants, exact-action authorization and approval, canonical arguments, exact compiled binding/digest/EffectIntent owner resolution and startup activation, Run-wide identities, authenticated provider lifetime/results, delegated recorded time, exclusive resource-stream Lease ownership, reconciliation/physical fencing, and retained pure Budget state with durable destination consumption.

telemetry.contract: No telemetry events, metrics or traces; read exposes durable business inputs and receipts, not a monitoring guarantee.

config.contract: Lifetime-static resource identity, deadline, positive rate, required nonnegative max_waiting, default stay or close pause policy, admitted budget reference/generation and immutable cleanup descriptor; exact settings required on recovery, no hot reconfiguration.

control.contract: Trusted command/2 serializes action admission, Run end, pause/continue/tick, current-intent dispatch, provider observations and events; renews ownership, commits decisions/receipts, distinguishes refusal and unknown outcomes. Host authority, activation, reconciliation and physical fencing remain Needs; no rearm, transfer or implicit cancellation.
